connector.name: Carbone MCP
connector.registryDescription: Generate PDF/DOCX/XLSX/PPTX from templates+JSON. Convert Office/HTML/MD to PDF. Universal templating
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.carbone.io over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package carbone-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.carbone, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CARBONE_API_KEY
env.description: Your Carbone API key from https://account.carbone.io. Required when using the Carbone cloud API. If CARBONE_BASE_URL points to an on-premise server, authentication is not required and this can be left empty.

env.name: CARBONE_BASE_URL
env.description: Custom Carbone API base URL for on-premise deployments. Defaults to https://api.carbone.io. When set to a custom URL, CARBONE_API_KEY is not required.
